scope: Twelve previously known development texts, not blind or representative general accuracy; local synthetic OCR reported separately

ui_observation_evidence: Twelve form submissions and terminal reports were observed by the parent operator in browser tool history; screenshot hashes identify the preserved images. The instrumentation label alone is not proof of UI use.

news_cap_observation.interpretation: The final assisted search records error with the physical news cap already reached, consistent with a locally blocked operation. The stored search record does not preserve the exact exception; no additional remote request is counted.

restart.qualification: One frozen evaluation across two server sessions; nine terminal records were preserved and only the three unreserved cases continued.

local_verification_before_post_measureme.scope: Offline automated verification reported by the parent operator; not factual accuracy or deployment evidence.

ocr_synthetic_local.scope: Synthetic local OCR controls only; no remote-media or authenticity validation. No unseen input texts, timings or dates are reconstructed.

post_measurement_correction.qualification: Implemented only after all twelve frozen cases and the passing freeze verification. The 7/12 belongs to the original frozen code; no new real accuracy has been measured.
post_measurement_correction.scope: English ordinal day/month and month/day date lines are context, including Sept. kept in one context block; no publication_date inference.

limits: Known reused controls are not a blind benchmark and do not establish 80% general accuracy.
Five inconclusives remain in the denominator; zero observed wrong conclusions does not mean 100% accuracy.
Searches, public pages, models and configuration changed since the previous measurement; the causal effect of code was not isolated.
Candidate rejection counts describe bounded candidate windows/directions, not independent source counts or an exhaustive semantic audit.
Public-fetch blocked_or_unavailable includes local safety blocks as well as remote unavailability; these counts are not all remote HTTP failures.
The authorized news cap was reached; the final case still concluded using three eligible families.
No retry-until-correct, paid models, recharge, key rotation or remote-media validation. Unused caps do not authorize extra cases.
Synthetic OCR fidelity does not establish authenticity, general OCR accuracy or the behavior of remote media detectors.
